{{Quote|I wonder how many they'll send. We've got so much firepower in here, these walls are ray-shielded. They can't take this fort. It'll probably be, uh, fifty Jedi. They'll need at least that many. Huh, maybe a hundred Jedi! They'll never take this base with less. Ha, they'll need an army of Jedi!|Oro Dassyne|audio=OroDassyne1-CW22.flac|<ref name="CW" />}}
[[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]], maintained a '''fort''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomis Koori IV]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]] structure helped the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], an ally of the Confederacy, since the planet was crucial to the defense of surrounding [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Due to the fort's importance, Dassyne increased its defensive [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. Along with the defensive emplacements, a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s stood guard within the structure. However, when two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;[[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|invaded]] Bomis Koori IV, Dassyne [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the onslaught, and his fort's defensive systems failed to stop the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] forces. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] later won the battle.

==Description==
[[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[General/Legends|general]], maintained a fort that was [[Color/Legends|gray]] in color. The structure's walls were [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]].<ref name="CW" /> Since the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomis Koori IV]] was important to the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], as it was described to be the fulcrum of its defense of surrounding [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], Dassyne increased the structure's defensive [[Artillery/Legends|arsenal]].<ref name="DB" /> As a result of the weapons buildup, [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] emplacements were present throughout the facade of the structure.<ref name="CW" /> The cocky General believed that the structure itself was impenetrable<ref name="DB" /> and imagined that it would take an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to capture it. Along with Dassyne, a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s were present in the fort.<ref name="CW" />

==History==
{{Quote|I have a visual.''"<br />"''Jedi?''"<br />"''I think so.|A battle droid and Dassyne converse in the fort|audio=OroDassyne2-CW22.flac|<ref name="CW" />}}
By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="chee" /> battle-worn Separatist General Oro Dassyne was given the opportunity to maintain a fort on Bomis Koori IV, an important Corporate Alliance world.<ref name="DB" /> During his [[Time/Legends|time]] in the fort, Dassyne's military style changed. Instead of relying on clever strategy, he wanted to spend all his efforts on fortifying his stronghold with more weaponry.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> However, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|initiated an attack]] on Bomis Koori IV. Despite Dassyne's belief that his fort was Jedi-resistant, both Kenobi and Skywalker infiltrated Dassyne's base and deactivated the ray [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] protecting the fort, rendering it vulnerable to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the world and direct strikes from ground forces. Dassyne was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the attack, and the Republic later won the battle.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fort first appeared in the [[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|twenty-second chapter]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 22]], [[2005]].<ref name="tv">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-xxii-370294|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars &ndash; Season 2, Episode 2: Chapter XXII}}</ref>
